scope: stage 2 -- the full per (curve, arm, fb_size, seed, T) table, columnar. Every aggregate in this contract is recomputable from these rows without rerunning anything.

sumset_sharing.verification_recomputations: the COMMITTED exp_icinv.decomposition_rate_m3 / _m2 are additionally called on the first 3 curves of the class to prove the shared set reproduces their hit counts exactly; those calls produce no measurement row and every reported hit count comes from the single shared enumeration

table.note: rate = hits_m3 / denominator. Arm A0's denominator is the REQUESTED target count (the defect it deliberately retains); A1, B and C use the number of targets actually used, which rejection sampling makes exactly T.
